notes: Single 77 K volumetric H2 isotherm on acid/baked ozonized HiPco SWNTs (sample 4), measured at NREL (Simpson/Heben, acknowledged). Figure 5 measured points (diamonds) extend only to about 3.5 bar (about 2.2 wt%); the headline 3 wt % at 77 K and 30 bar is read from the Langmuir-Freundlich fit line, so it is a fitted value, but the measured points' T and P are recoverable from the caption and axes. Surface area is N2-BET (Micromeritics ASAP 2010, multipoint), Table 2 and text; 1068 m2/g for the same treated sample used for H2 uptake. The approx. 2.4 wt % value for purified SWNTs is cited from ref. 29 (Panella et al.), not measured here; no statement that the paper's own uptake data were published before. No supplementary files in the input.
